nodes.label: Spark-to-Paper: End-to-End Research Paper Generation as a Composable Skill
nodes.author: Zhuoyang Qian, Biao Wu, Yiran Wang, Chris D Yan, Desan Dai, Liangwei Zheng, Jin Jiang, Junsheng Zhang, Wenhao Wang

nodes.label: Spark-to-Paper System
nodes.rationale: End-to-end research paper generation implemented as thirteen composable skills inside coding assistant; separates model judgment from deterministic operations

nodes.label: Skill-Based Research Automation
nodes.rationale: Design principle: each skill handles specific research task (planning, literature, writing, review, figures, experiments); skills communicate through shared project artifacts

nodes.label: Precommitted Experiment Design
nodes.rationale: Separates experiment planning from reporting; evidence required by manuscript specified before results observed; lightweight preregistration within pipeline

nodes.label: Deterministic Integrity Checks
nodes.rationale: Machine-checkable constraints: template structure, citation consistency, notation, figure files, LaTeX compilation, result integrity; gates enforce verifiable properties

nodes.label: Long-Horizon Self-Critique
nodes.rationale: Two levels: Self-Review (local after edit), Adversarial Review (manuscript-level from complementary perspectives); enables later evidence to change earlier decisions

nodes.label: Bounded Self-Refutation Loop Recovery
nodes.rationale: Bounds experiment–critique–revision cycles to seven; unsuccessful trajectories recorded as failure reports; system restarts from new idea rather than forcing success

nodes.label: Editable Vector Figure Generation
nodes.rationale: Role-aware generation: measured results from deterministic plotting, method figures from image generation then code reconstruction; achieves 96.4% figure editability

nodes.label: Evidence-Grounded Claim Revision
nodes.rationale: Claims classified as SUPPORTED/PARTIALLY-SUPPORTED/UNSUPPORTED/CONTRADICTED/NEEDS-CONFIRMATION; retained, weakened, removed, or trigger additional experiments

nodes.label: Citation Validity and Fabrication Detection
nodes.rationale: Achieves 99.5% citation validity; fabrication detection increases from 14% (single-pass) to 92% (full stack); adversarial review achieves 74% precision

nodes.label: Cost-Efficient Paper Generation
nodes.rationale: Full system uses 11.9M tokens, costs $8.1 per manuscript, requires 3.2 hours; lightweight design without separate agent platform or orchestration service

nodes.label: Spark-to-Paper: Structured Empirical Research Automation
nodes.rationale: Automated manuscript generation system with deterministic gates for evidence integrity and claim verification

nodes.label: Deterministic Gates and Failure Conditions
nodes.rationale: Verification mechanism distinguishing machine-checkable properties (artifact existence, evidence grounding, citation resolution, compilation) from semantic judgment

nodes.label: Claim Admission Protocol
nodes.rationale: Evidence-based claim assessment with five labels (supported, partially-supported, unsupported, contradicted, needs-confirmation) and corresponding revision actions

nodes.label: Evidence-Grounded Experiment Execution
nodes.rationale: Procedure identifying evidence requirements from claims, assessing feasibility, executing experiments, verifying provenance, and propagating revisions
